setup.expr: (function(){var t=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-tabs .tab:not([data-editor-change])'))[0];if(!t)return 'NO_TAB';var eid=t.getAttribute('data-editor-identifier');var m=(function(){var ms=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('menu-drop'));for(var i=0;i<ms.length;i++){if((function(){var op=ms[i].opener;if(!op)return false;var t='';for(var n=op.firstChild;n;n=n.nextSibling){if(n.nodeType===3)t+=n.nodeValue;}return t.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim()==="Preview";})())return ms[i];}return null;})();if(!m||!m.main)return 'NO_MENU';m.open();var li=m.main.querySelector('li[data-editor-identifier="'+eid+'"]');if(!li)return 'NO_ITEM';li.click();return true;})()

(function(){var m=(function(){var ms=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('menu-drop'));for(var i=0;i<ms.length;i++){if((function(){var op=ms[i].opener;if(!op)return false;var t='';for(var n=op.firstChild;n;n=n.nextSibling){if(n.nodeType===3)t+=n.nodeValue;}return t.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim()==="Preview";})())return ms[i];}return null;})();if(!m||!m.main)return 'NO_MENU';m.open();var li=m.main.querySelector('li[data-value="active-editor"]');if(!li)return 'NO_ITEM';li.click();return true;})()
